title: Spot 6 Differences
description: Put your observation skills to the test in Find 6 Differences, a fun and relaxing puzzle game! With 20 unique levels, each featuring two nearly identical images, your goal is simple: find the 6 differences before time runs out! 20 challenging levels with beautifully designed images and engaging gameplay that sharpens your attention to detail. Hint system to help you when youre stuck. Think you have a sharp eye? Play Find 6 Differences now and prove your skills!
instructions: Tap on the images to play this game
